sentences: If you feel stuck playing a part that isn't really you, that's probably your "Role-Self," and as we grow up it gets hardened by Dopamine and DeltaFosB until it's like a prison.
Your addiction is often just the fuel it takes to keep that Role-Self running.
So this protocol is about dissolving the chemical glue that holds the false persona together, so your "True-Self" (the person you were before the trauma) can finally come back out.
